selection: first training qids ascending; first unique training vids ascending; no labels or scores
checkpoint_loading_rule: identical cached FP32 state dict in both CLIP implementations; strictly matching keys/tensors; separately report upstream half-rounding path
pixel_probe: 9 official fps=1/2 FFmpeg raw 224 crops; 9 pipeline JPEG512/PIL crops at matching source frame indices; compare against existing 1fps cache at 0,2,4 seconds
scope: mechanical input parity only; no locator weights, training, GT inference, validation/fresh queries, mAP or API
stop_rule: retain every parity failure; no threshold/token-length/phase search; current cache cannot be called compatible unless all input axes match
